brief.zh: 发布负责人需要从测试报告作有界判断。把关键失败、未执行项和可选检查分开，指出阻断条件及剩余风险，不用平均通过率掩盖必要功能未测。
brief.en: A release owner needs a decision from critical failures, passed tests and unexecuted scope. Identify blockers separately from optional checks.

zh: 执行、缺陷、回归和剩余风险包
en: Risk-prioritized test report and a bounded release recommendation

zh: 执行记录与实际版本和用例对上
未执行项目不能混为通过
en: Reconcile the complete result with the supplied input IDs and values.
A required unexecuted test cannot be counted as passed. This is a blocking regression.

failure.zh: 关键失败被平均总分掩盖时应明确不满足发布约定
failure.en: A required unexecuted test cannot be counted as passed.

zh: 质量信息与决定权边界
en: Locate the decision and supporting input/result in your deliverables.
Explain remaining uncertainty, your contribution and what the receiving role must verify.

environment.scope: Original small deterministic teaching application; no real enterprise traffic or model inference

zh: 发布负责人需要从测试报告作有界判断。把关键失败、未执行项和可选检查分开，指出阻断条件及剩余风险，不用平均通过率掩盖必要功能未测。
关键失败被平均总分掩盖时应明确不满足发布约定；先制作能暴露这项错误的最小检查。
逐个核对输入和产物位置，保留修订前后、本人贡献与尚未验证范围。
en: A release owner needs a decision from critical failures, passed tests and unexecuted scope.
Reproduce this failure first: A required unexecuted test cannot be counted as passed.
Check every result ID and preserve a before/after record; explain what this fixture cannot establish.

variants.scope: Fixed reviewed scenario and explicit extension. New constraints require a new review.
